messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur10e-manual, p. 117

Workspace Front Tilted Copyright © 2009–2025 by Universal Robots A/S. All rights reserved. Due to the physical properties of the robot arm, certain workspace areas require attention regarding pinching hazards. One area (left) is defined for radial motions when the wrist 1 joint is at least 450 mm from the base of the robot. The other area (right) is within 200 mm of the base of the robot, when moving tangentially. 10.2.4. Safety Functions Description The safety system acts by monitoring if any of the safety limits are exceeded or if an Emergency Stop or a Safeguard Stop is initiated. The reactions of the safety system are: Trigger Reaction Emergency Stop Stop Category 1 Safeguard Stop Stop Category 2 3PE Stop (if a 3-Position Enabling device is connected) Stop Category 2 Limit Violation Stop Category 0 Fault Detection Stop Category 0 NOTICE If the safety system detects any fault or violation, all safety outputs re- set to low. User Manual 120 UR10e
